crf.description: CRF (constant rate factor), 0-63, default is 35. Lower is better quality.

preset.description: SVT-AV1 preset, 0-13, default is 12. Higher is faster (lower quality).

rtc.description:
Real-time low-delay (RTC) mode. Default true for remote desktop so the
encoder emits a packet per input frame instead of buffering a deep
look-ahead window.
